name: Up to Snuff
summary: In Booty Bay, Deeg is waiting for the snuff he likes, but the herbalist has none to sell. Bloodsail Raiders are said to have taken the shipment, and Deeg asks you to bring him fifteen shares.

sections.title: Vices Ashore
sections.body:
Deeg knows life at sea may be poor, yet it is the only life he has. Whenever he reaches port, he looks for grog and fine snuff.

The Booty Bay herbalist has run out. The herbalist says Bloodsail Raiders hijacked the shipment, so Deeg hopes a fearless traveler can persuade them to share it. He wants fifteen shares of snuff.

sections.title: Deeg's Thanks
sections.body: Deeg is delighted when the snuff arrives just before he ships out. He thanks you warmly, as he would an old friend.

faq.answer: Deeg is a pirate in Booty Bay who looks for grog and fine snuff whenever he comes to port.

faq.q: Why is the herbalist out of snuff?
faq.answer: The Booty Bay herbalist says Bloodsail Raiders hijacked the shipment of snuff.
The herbalist says Bloodsail Raiders hijacked the shipment, and Deeg hopes you can persuade them to share it.

faq.q: How much snuff does Deeg want?
faq.answer: Deeg wants fifteen shares of snuff brought to him in Booty Bay.
